notes: POC goal: validate Dedicated can meet 95% P99 latency < 250ms for 1k token median workloads while sustaining 200 RPS steady-state and 600 RPS 5-min peaks
Customer workload: low-latency chat + real-time reranking for search results; embedding generation for fraud feature vectors asynchronously
Representative prompts: short interactive prompts (15-60 tokens) for chat; batch rerank requests (10-50 candidates); embedding payloads (avg 512 tokens)
Performance acceptance criteria: 95th latency <120ms, 99th latency <250ms for single-turn chat at target RPS; throughput linearity during scale-up; tail latency reproducible in soak test
POC plan (6 weeks):
- Week 1: baseline profiling on hosted models & map to hardware (H100 vs A100 tradeoffs)
- Week 2: Dedicated staging environment provision + KMS test keys + SSO smoke
- Week 3: Synthetic load tests (gradual ramp to 600 RPS) with 1h soak windows; collect p50/p95/p99 and GPU utilization
- Week 4: Representative prompt soak (48h) using production prompt set (~500 prompts) to catch memory growth/KV cache regressions
- Week 5: Failure injection (node drain, network jitter) to validate graceful fallback to smaller model variants and routing policies
- Week 6: Final tuning, cost projection, SLA draft review with procurement/infra
Reserved GPU ask: start with 8 x H100-equivalent (mixed-family allowed), option to scale +4 after Week 3 depending on batching/quantization gains
Batching preferences: prefer continuous batching with 10-30ms max queueing; customer stressed limits on added latency >20ms
Caching: prefix + KV cache critical for chat; want cache hit metrics surfaced per-route
Observability reqs: per-route p50/p95/p99, token-level cost, GPU mem spikes, per-request trace id for user request -> model invocation
Security: legal asked for explicit KMS envelope flow and audit log retention 7 years (we recommended 1 year + archive), SSO (SAML) required
Procurement note: budget window closes 2026-04-15; they want a firm SLO + SLA appendix before committing to annual reserved contract
